content.en: Separate the Ally cards by side. Each player shuffles their 7 cards, secretly draws **3**, and sets the rest aside. Each player takes a player aid and **1 Power token**. At the start of every Chapter, add **2 Power tokens** to the marked positions in that Chapter's display.
content.zh: 按阵营分开盟友牌。每位玩家洗匀自己的 7 张，暗抽 **3** 张，其余放到一旁。每位玩家拿 1 张帮助卡和 **1 枚能力标记**。每个章节开始时，在该章节牌阵的指定位置放 **2 枚能力标记**。

content.en: Did you take a Chapter card with a Power token? Take the token **first**, put it in your personal supply, then resolve the card normally.
content.zh: 是否拿取了一张带能力标记的章节牌？先拿取该标记，放入自己的供应区，再正常结算章节牌。

alt.en: Take the Power token from a Chapter card before resolving the card
alt.zh: 从带有能力标记的章节牌上先拿取标记，再结算该牌

content.en: At any point in your turn, including after revealing a new Chapter card, you may summon **one** Ally as an extra action. You may not summon a second Ally this turn.
content.zh: 在自己回合的任意时刻，包括刚翻开新的章节牌之后，可以把召唤 **1 名**盟友作为额外行动。本回合不能再召唤第二名盟友。

label.en: Use an Ally already in play

content.en: Spend **1 Power token**. Flip one of your secret Ally cards face up in front of you, then resolve the effect on its left side. That Ally stays in front of you for now.
content.zh: 弃掉 **1 枚能力标记**。翻开自己面前 1 张暗置盟友牌，执行左侧的入场效果。这名盟友暂时留在你面前。

content.en: Choose an Ally already face up in front of you. Spend **2 Power tokens**, resolve its right-side exit effect, then set that card aside. It cannot be used again this game. An Ally must enter before it can exit.
content.zh: 选择 1 名已在你面前正面朝上的盟友。弃掉 **2 枚能力标记**，执行右侧退场效果，然后将该牌放到一旁；本局不能再次使用。盟友必须先入场，才能退场。

alt.en: Spend one token to reveal an Ally and resolve its entry effect; later spend two tokens to use its exit effect and set it aside
alt.zh: 花费 1 枚标记翻开盟友并执行入场效果；之后花费 2 枚标记执行退场效果并将其移出游戏

content.en: Your normal turn is unchanged: take a Chapter card or Landmark tile. Allies are an extra action only. The Ring quest, Races, regions, conflicts, and all victory conditions use the base-game rules.
content.zh: 正常回合不变：拿取章节牌或地标。盟友只是额外行动。魔戒远征、种族、地区、冲突和全部胜利条件仍按基础游戏执行。
